title: Update bundled libpng to 1.6.56 to fix CVE-2026-33416 (use-after-free) and CVE-2026-33636 (OOB read/write)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.dev [4a919adccf8e398aceca75399c539078c54fe97f], 4.6.3-rc [8421c61c7edd9a19e3f147a7a57813db23539ed5], 4.5.3-rc [c434c4528ad1aeaefbda80816b397bfb51f466cd]

### System information

All platforms - all versions bundling libpng 1.6.55

### Issue description

The bundled `thirdparty/libpng` (version 1.6.55) is affected by two
high-severity CVEs disclosed in March 2026:

### CVE-2026-33416 — Use-after-free (CVSS 8.1, High)
`png_set_tRNS` and `png_set_PLTE` improperly alias a single heap-allocated
buffer between `png_struct` and `png_info`, which have independent lifetimes.
A crafted PNG with PLTE/tRNS chunks can trigger a use-after-free, leading to
process crashes, heap memory disclosure, or potentially arbitrary code execution.

### CVE-2026-33636 — Out-of-bounds read/write (CVSS 7.1, High)
An OOB read/write in the ARM/AArch64 Neon-optimized palette expansion routines.
Affects Android and iOS/ARM builds.

- Advisory: https://github.com/pnggroup/libpng/security/advisories/GHSA-m4pc-p4q3-4c7j ,  https://github.com/pnggroup/libpng/security/advisories/GHSA-wjr5-c57x-95m2

### Impact on Godot
Godot uses the libpng Simplified API (`png_image_begin_read_from_memory` /
`png_image_finish_read`) in `drivers/png/png_driver_common.cpp`. While Godot
does not call `png_set_tRNS` or `png_set_PLTE` directly, these functions are
invoked **internally by libpng** when reading PNG files that contain PLTE or
tRNS chunks (see `thirdparty/libpng/pngrutil.c:1069` and `:1778`).

Additionally, the bundled FreeType and HarfBuzz libraries call
`png_set_tRNS_to_alpha()` when processing embedded PNG glyphs in fonts
(`thirdparty/freetype/src/sfnt/pngshim.c:371`,
`thirdparty/harfbuzz/src/hb-raster-image.cc:499`).

Any application that loads a maliciously crafted PNG image or font is
potentially vulnerable.

### Fix
Update `thirdparty/libpng` from 1.6.55 to **1.6.56**, which decouples
the buffer lifetimes and enforces strict loop boundaries.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Build Godot from master (bundled libpng 1.6.55 is used by default)
2. Load a crafted PNG file containing specially constructed PLTE/tRNS chunks
   that trigger the use-after-free condition described in CVE-2026-33416
3. Observe crash or memory corruption

Note: This is a known upstream vulnerability with a published fix.
No proof-of-concept is provided to avoid misuse — refer to the upstream
advisory for technical details.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
